name: Ever-Evolving Science Exam (EESE)
description: EESE is a dynamic benchmark designed to reliably assess scientific capabilities of foundation models, featuring a large non-public pool of over 100K science instances and a periodically updated 500-instance subset for leakage-resilient, low-overhead evaluations across 5 disciplines and 500+ subfields.
reputation: A new dynamic science benchmark intended to reduce leakage and provide a more reliable evaluation of foundation models, but it is still emerging rather than broadly adopted.
notes: Addresses data leakage and evaluation inefficiency; evaluates scientific understanding and cognitive dimensions.
